text_markup: Any time the current timing step of the run is moved to a different phase of the run, except for an instruction to end the run (See {ref:rule_end_the_run}, below), no more steps in the previously-active phase are carried out. If a paid ability window is open, players complete that window normally. Then the active phase is complete and a checkpoint occurs. Finally, the game proceeds to the new phase.
text_plain: Any time the current timing step of the run is moved to a different phase of the run, except for an instruction to end the run (See section 6.1.4, below), no more steps in the previously-active phase are carried out. If a paid ability window is open, players complete that window normally. Then the active phase is complete and a checkpoint occurs. Finally, the game proceeds to the new phase.
